Game Overview

Crazy Bridge Rush Build Stash and Run puts players into a casual experience centered on race across vibrant rooftops, build rainbow bridges with your blocks, and outwit opponents in this thrilling speed-building challenge. Test your reflexes, construct bridges faster, and conquer daunting levels in a dynamic mix of strategy and action. Can you master the art of speed and strategy to claim victory?
